label: ERW forecast

methods.what: the method chosen for the place by the rule of the method note (the lowest mean absolute error of the ERW's methods over the last two years of the backtest)
the operator's own day-ahead demand forecast, as filed on Form EIA-930 (eia930_forecast_error_hourly, the screened hours left out); for the price none is published, and its rows are held
the same local hour of the latest whole day held when the forecast is made (two days before the target day, for the day-ahead forecast)
the same local hour seven days before the target day
the least-squares regression of the method note, one a local hour, refit for every day on the 730 days before it

metrics.mae: mean absolute error, in the series' unit
metrics.mape: mean absolute percent error, in percent

mape_rule: Demand: every hour scored (demand is always above zero). Price: only hours whose actual price is at least 5 USD/MWh in size; a percent of a price near zero means nothing, and the cell is null when no hour qualifies.

cuts.all: every hour of the backtest held by every method
cuts.last_2_years: the last 730 days of the backtest (the days the method is chosen on)
cuts.hour: key 0 to 23, the place's clock, over the last two years
cuts.top10: the place's ten highest-demand days of the backtest (by the day's peak hour)
cuts.spike: price only: the hours above the grid's 99th percentile
